Don Brown was third and Percy Wright fourth in the 2 miles walk, and Eddie Pack (49.2) finished fourth in the final of the 440 yards. We were glad to see J. Dodd, representing N.C.A.A., win the Pole Vault.
This produces an interesting situation in the high jump where J. Dodd's 1936 record of 6'3½ converts to 1.91m, as does Reg Hopkins' 1972 leap of 6'3¼.
We were also glad to see J.Dodd, representing the Northern Counties A.A., win the Pole Vault. The "Sporting Life" compiled a table giving winners six points down to one point for sixth place.
